market_name: Will China invade Taiwan by end of 2026?

time_plan.30m: Check whether the Polymarket probability spike is corroborated by any newswire (Reuters/Bloomberg) headlines on PLA activity, missile launches, or diplomatic statements; confirm EWT/TSM pre-market or intraday quote direction.
time_plan.1h: Re-check if VIX and USD/JPY are moving risk-off in tandem; look for Taiwan MOFA or PLA Eastern Theater Command announcements that would validate the market move.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether the probability move has held or reverted; a quick reversion suggests noise/manipulation rather than genuine information leakage.
time_plan.6h: Review Asia session open reaction in TAIEX futures and TSMC ADR; gauge whether institutional flow confirms the signal.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate full-window EWT return vs prediction, note whether any public confirmation emerged, and whether the move was front-run by this market.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp upward move in the implied probability of a China invasion of Taiwan is the single most direct bearish catalyst for Taiwanese equities. EWT is heavily weighted toward TSMC and other Taiwan-domiciled names whose physical operations, supply chains, and sovereignty premium would be directly impaired by escalation risk. Even a probability spike short of actual invasion would trigger a sharp repricing of Taiwan risk and capital flight. The move is asymmetric: this is a low-base-rate tail event, so most of the time the signal is noise, but when the market moves materially the downside in EWT is large.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm whether gold is actually catching a safe-haven bid alongside USD strength and falling equity index futures.
time_plan.1h: Distinguish whether gold move is geopolitical risk-driven vs rate/dollar-driven; check DXY and real yields.
time_plan.2h: Check if the risk-off impulse is broad (JPY, CHF, Treasuries all bid) or isolated, which would weaken the gold thesis.
time_plan.6h: Reassess gold vs the Taiwan equity move; if EWT fell hard but gold did not rally, downgrade the haven mapping.
time_plan.12h: Compare full-window GLD return to prediction and note whether magnitude stayed sub-threshold as expected.

predictions.reasoning: An escalation in Taiwan-invasion probability is a classic global risk-off shock that typically bids safe havens (gold, USD, Treasuries). Gold would benefit from flight-to-safety demand and geopolitical hedging. However, the mapping is weaker and lower-magnitude than the direct Taiwan-equity hit: gold's response to geopolitical headlines is inconsistent, can be blunted by a stronger USD, and often fades. I keep direction up but confidence modest and magnitude likely below the 700bp tradable threshold.

evidence_used: Market question concerns a binary, low-base-rate tail event: China military offensive against Taiwan by end-2026
Taiwan is the global center of advanced semiconductor manufacturing (TSMC), making its equity index highly sensitive to conflict risk
Geopolitical escalation historically drives risk-off flows into gold, USD, and Treasuries
EWT and GLD are liquid, broadly-traded ETFs suitable as proxies
uncertainty_notes: Prediction markets on extreme tail events are thin and prone to manipulation/noise; a probability 'spike' may be illiquid wiggle rather than information
Direction and magnitude depend entirely on the market MOVING sharply; absent a move there is no signal
Gold's geopolitical response is historically inconsistent and can be offset by dollar strength
If an actual invasion occurred, moves would be far larger and markets could gap/halt, breaking linear bps estimates

llm_justification.summary: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a China invasion of Taiwan would be a direct, large bearish catalyst for Taiwanese equities (EWT, TSMC-heavy) and a modest bid for safe-haven gold (GLD). The Taiwan-equity leg is the strongest, highest-magnitude mapping and is the only one plausibly clearing the 700bp tradable threshold; the gold leg is a weaker, lower-conviction risk-off hedge. Both depend on the market actually moving materially — this is a low-base-rate tail event where most observations are noise.
key_assumptions: The prediction-market probability moves sharply and materially (not a thin-liquidity blip)
A probability spike reflects genuine escalation risk rather than manipulation
EWT remains tradable and not halted during the window
Semiconductor concentration keeps Taiwan equities highly sensitive to cross-strait risk
failure_modes: The probability move reverts within hours, revealing it as noise or a single large bettor, with no asset follow-through
The escalation news is already public and priced in, so EWT does not move on the market signal
The gold proxy is weakly exposed and fails to rally as USD strength dominates
Thin prediction-market liquidity produces a false signal uncorrelated with real-world events
In a genuine invasion, markets gap or halt and realized moves vastly exceed the estimated bps, breaking the linear mapping
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
